gloss: critical speed; limiting speed; maximum safe speed

definitions.gloss: critical speed; the maximum speed something can sustain
definitions.explanation: The upper speed at which a vehicle, machine, or moving body can still operate safely or stably; beyond it, control or structural integrity is lost. A technical term in physics and engineering.

examples.japanese: {限界速度|げんかいそくど}を{超|こ}えた。
この{機械|きかい}には{限界速度|げんかいそくど}がある。
examples.english: This machine has a maximum operating speed.

examples.japanese: カーブで{限界速度|げんかいそくど}を{超|こ}えると、{車|くるま}は{制御|せいぎょ}を{失|うしな}う{恐|おそ}れがある。
examples.english: If you exceed the critical speed on a curve, the car may lose control.

notes:
Formed from {限界|げんかい} (limit) plus {速度|そくど} (speed). It names the speed beyond which safe or stable operation breaks down, and is mostly a technical term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {限界速度|げんかいそくど}を{超|こ}える: to exceed the critical speed
- {限界速度|げんかいそくど}に{達|たっ}する: to reach the limiting speed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {制限速度|せいげんそくど}: speed limit — the legally set maximum for a road, not a physical limit
- {最高速度|さいこうそくど}: top speed — the fastest a vehicle can go, without the safety nuance
